name: Aelnir Color Sort
seoTitle: Aelnir Color Sort: offline water sort puzzle game for Android
summary: Pour coloured liquid between tubes until every tube holds one colour. Offline, with solver-checked levels.
tagline: A calm sorting puzzle with 500 levels, a daily challenge and endless play. No account, works offline.

features.title: Sort, relax, repeat
features.lead: Move coloured segments between tubes until each holds a single colour.

items.title: 500 solver-checked levels
items.body: Every campaign level is solved by a solver first, with a proven best score and a difficulty curve that rises and eases.

items.title: Daily challenge and endless
items.body: A fresh offline daily puzzle with a streak, plus endless play from Easy to Expert.

items.title: Help when you want it
items.body: Unlimited undo, free restart, solver-backed hints, and up to two extra tubes on a level.

items.title: Themes
items.body: Six themes, including a ball-sort look. Three are free and three unlock with coins you earn.

items.title: Made to be accessible
items.body: Colour-blind patterns and letters, reduced motion, left-handed controls, sound and haptics you can turn off.

items.title: Kind to your attention
items.body: No banner ever appears on the board. Ads show only on Home, Levels and Stats.

strip.label: Modes
strip.text: Campaign · Daily · Endless · Hints · Undo · 6 themes

note.label: Free, with ads
note.title: No ads on the board
note.body: Aelnir Color Sort is free and supported by ads, which never appear while you play a level. No account is needed and progress is saved on your phone.

studioProof.hard: A deterministic sorting engine with solver-backed level generation, not a list of hand-drawn layouts.
